_comment: PERSISTENT LEAGUE MEMORY for JAAFFL. Any coding or agent work MUST read this file (and CLAUDE.md) BEFORE beginning, to avoid loss of critical configuration. These settings are owner-provided and IMMUTABLE — never paraphrase, summarize, or change them without explicit owner approval. Scoring values are owner-confirmed as of 2026-07-17 (no longer CBS-inferred).

league.name: JAAFFL2025

draft_order.method: Decided in-person, then entered into CBS Sports system
draft_order.note: Do NOT assume a simple snake order from team count alone. The actual order is decided in person and entered into CBS; read the real order from the CBS draft room.

draft_day.timezone_note: Owner said 'EST'. On 2026-08-22 Eastern is EDT (UTC-04:00), not EST (UTC-05:00). The authoritative value is the WALL CLOCK the owner means: 5:00 PM local Eastern = 17:00 America/New_York = 21:00 UTC. Do NOT re-derive this from the literal string 'EST' or you will be one hour early.
draft_day.team_number_note: The owner's draft slot and team number are DECIDED IN PERSON ON DRAFT DAY and are NOT knowable in advance. JAAFFL_MY_TEAM_ID in .env MUST therefore stay empty until 2026-08-22 and be set on the day, once the order is entered into CBS and the owner reads his team number off the board. An empty JAAFFL_MY_TEAM_ID before draft day is EXPECTED and is not a defect to fix.

league.scoring_note: Owner-confirmed JAAFFL2025 custom scoring (2026-07-17), non-PPR (0 per reception). Passing = 1 pt / 50 yds (0.02/yd); rush/rec = 0.1/yd; all TDs = 6; 2-pt = 2; NO offensive INT/fumble penalty. K: FG 3, +1 at 50-59, +1 more at 60+, XP 1. DST: sack 1, INT 2, fumble recovery 2, safety 2, def/ST TD 6, points-allowed 0-9 = 6 (no yards-allowed tier). Typed map: backend/src/jaaffl/league/defaults.py::jaaffl_scoring (single source; this note documents, code encodes).

roster_derived_facts.starters_breakdown: QB 1 + RB 1 + WR 3 + WR/RB flex 1 + TE 1 + K 1 + DST 1 = 9
roster_derived_facts.picks_equal_rounds: 9 starters + 8 bench = 17 = draft_rounds; every pick fills a roster slot.
strategic_notes: WR-HEAVY roster: 3 mandatory WR starters PLUS a WR/RB-only flex (no TE eligibility in flex). Only 1 RB is mandatory to start.
Standard (non-PPR) scoring de-emphasizes high-volume/possession receivers relative to PPR, but the 3WR + WR/RB-flex requirement raises league-wide WR demand regardless.
K and DST each occupy exactly 1 starting slot; conventional strategy drafts them last (final 1-2 rounds).
Deep bench (8) over 17 rounds allows handcuffs, upside stashes, and positional insurance.

hard_constraints_verbatim: Draft Order: Decided in-person, then entered into CBS Sports system
Scoring Format: Custom (non-PPR) — JAAFFL2025 owner-confirmed 2026-07-17 (see scoring_note; typed map in league/defaults.jaaffl_scoring)
Roster Slots per Team: QB = 1, RB = 1, WR = 3, WR/RB = 1, TE = 1, K = 1, DST = 1, Bench = 8
agent_usage_contract: Before any draft-system implementation, an agent must (1) load this file, (2) treat every value in 'league' and 'hard_constraints_verbatim' as fixed input, (3) compute replacement/VOR baselines against THIS roster (not generic defaults), and (4) surface — not silently change — any apparent conflict with these settings.
